description: Load a QBlade sample project, make a modification, and save it under a new name. Open QBlade and load one of the sample project files (.wpa) from /home/ga/Documents/sample_projects/. After the project is loaded, generate a NACA 0015 airfoil using the NACA generator in the Airfoil Design module to add it to the project. Then save the modified project to /home/ga/Documents/projects/my_turbine.wpa using File > Save Project As.
